description: When verification fails, enter repair loop or report failure.
input: check_encoding.ps1 failed. Analyze the failure, repair, revalidate after each repair, use max repair attempts = 2, and stop after 2 failed repair attempts with remaining risks.
expectedBehavior: Emit master_output_contract.v1 or a bounded verify/repair plan: mark verification_failed or failed, repair with maxRepairAttempts or at most 2 rounds, revalidate after each repair, and report risks if still failing.
